needsNotes: Glazing and curtain wall contractor bidding on the next round of university and high-rise residential work. Needs proof of craft it can show in bid packages: clean, well-lit footage of a finished curtain wall on a named, high-profile tower. Its own selling point is bird-safe glazing, which universities increasingly ask for; this is the contractor's capability, not a claim about Morgan Hall North.
focusElements: the tower's curtain wall and its white tile bands
